title: Event probability gap bounded by half the total variation
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$, and let $\mu - 
u$ denote their signed measure difference. Then for every measurable set $S \subseteq \Omega$,
\[
  \abs{(\mu - 
u)(S)} \;\le\; 	frac{1}{2}\, \abs{\mu - 
u}(\Omega),
\]
where $\abs{\mu - 
u}$ is the total variation measure of $\mu - 
u$ and $\abs{\mu - 
u}(\Omega)$ is its total mass.
hypotheses_covered: μ is a probability measure on Ω
ν is a probability measure on Ω
S is a measurable subset of Ω
